name: translator
description: High-performance, generic multilingual translator supporting 50+ languages, conversational dialects (Gujlish, Hinglish, etc.), custom user glossaries, and pluggable backends (Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI).

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text between any languages worldwide (English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Hindi, Gujarati, Arabic, etc.) and colloquial chat dialects (Gujlish, Hinglish) with customizable tone and glossaries.
